evaluation_items.question: A student wants to simulate a 50-qubit circuit made only of H, S and CNOT gates, starting from |0…0⟩, and measure all qubits. Which simulator type would you recommend and why?
evaluation_items.expected_answer: A stabilizer simulator, because the circuit is Clifford-only and therefore efficiently simulable (Gottesman–Knill); a state-vector simulator would need 2⁵⁰ × 16 bytes = 16 PiB.
